notes.title: Broken Sword - Shadow of the Templars getting remastered, plus a whole new adventure
notes.notes:
Revolution Software recently announced two huge bits of news for adventure game fans! Not only will there be a whole new game with Broken Sword - Parzival's Stone but Broken Sword - Shadow of the Templars: Reforged is coming too.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2023/09/broken-sword-shadow-of-the-templars-getting-remastered-plus-a-whole-new-adventure
